method.admission: A call completes only when it returns without error and its output passes mechanical admission after the clock stops: SVG must parse to an svg root with positive size; PNG must have a PNG signature and positive dimensions; terminal text must be non-empty after removing control sequences. Error placeholders (aria-roledescription="error"), outputs led by a renderer error phrase absent from the source, and terminal text that only echoes the source are failures. No drawing meaning is judged and outputs are not retained.
method.elapsed: Sum of awaited render/export calls, including failures; initialization, warm-up, reporting and cleanup excluded. Native CLI includes process startup.
method.png: Browser SVG + shared Chromium canvas PNG conversion unless a prepared native PNG path is available. No image inspection.

rankingRule.primary: More completed examples is better; use the minimum completion count across three complete runs.
rankingRule.secondary: For equal completion counts, lower median total render/export time is better when every tied row uses the same boundary kind (fresh process or persistent API).
rankingRule.ties: Identical completion counts share a rank when their boundary kinds differ, or when their median times are identical.
rankingRule.scope: Rank SVG, PNG and terminal text separately through the declared public execution paths. Native CLI time includes per-example process startup.
rankingRule.incomplete: Fewer than three complete runs, or mixed versions/boundaries, remain unranked.
